name: Replit
shortDescription: Browser IDE with a coding agent.
longDescription: Replit is a browser IDE with a coding agent. The recorded free plan includes up to 30 hours of chat and 60 projects. Confirm the current plan on the official pricing page.
pricingNotes: Confirm the current plan on the official pricing page.
freeTierNotes: Up to 30 hours of chat and 60 projects.
bestFor: Coding in the browser, once you confirm the current product yourself
notIdealFor: Anyone relying on this card as a completed check
strength: The recorded free plan includes up to 30 hours of chat and 60 projects in the browser IDE.
weakness: Free chat stops at 30 hours and 60 projects, and Core starts at $20 per month.
smokeTestNotes: No local install attempted (SaaS/desktop/extension or install not feasible without account).

useCaseFit.coding-agents: Browser IDE with a coding agent, and a recorded free plan of 30 chat hours.
